response.overview: In 1845, two close friends struggle to survive in a poverty-stricken town plagued by drugs, crime, and desperation. With no hope for a better life, they stumble upon a mysterious plant that seems to have the power to change their lives forever. But what begins as a chance at a new life soon draws the attention of dangerous people, forcing the two friends to risk everything to protect their discovery.
response.title: Dhar Ma Nafa
